g.title: journal.json is absent; this is physical absence, not a stored phase. A writer lock may still exist, and absence alone does not make a reader snapshot available or establish cleanup success.

A validated retained journal has phase=prepared and exact before/candidate evidence. Targets may match a mixture of retained before and candidate values during an unfinished transaction; that mixture is not usable current state.
A validated retained journal has phase=committed. Every target must match its candidate identity; before-state targets are inconsistent. Only verified completion/cleanup is admissible, never restore.
